verdict.rationale: Slack's own docs describe Workflow Builder as a no-code way to build workflows right in Slack. Any user can combine steps and triggers, with documented webhook triggers and conditional branching, so the core of the story is delivered. The docs call it a "limited set" of steps and triggers, and the specific trigger types the story names are not spelled out. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of event-based, scheduled, and form-submission triggers; admin-specific controls; independent or hands-on corroboration.
